data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian words 'del' meaning night and 'naz' meaning light. Delnaz symbolizes the radiance and beauty that illuminates even the darkest hours. The name Delnaz carries the meaning “Light of the night” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Delnaz usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the night and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_urdu.name: دلناز
